capabilities.name: category-aggregate
capabilities.description: Read the m_provision_category aggregate (id, categoryName, categoryDescription) by its primary key, as returned by GET /v1/provisioningcategory.
capabilities.evidence: Capture CAT-00 under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned the four category rows (1 STANDARD, 2 SUB-STANDARD, 3 DOUBTFUL, 4 LOSS), each with a non-empty categoryDescription.

capabilities.name: reserve-amount
capabilities.description: Read the aggregated reserve amount (amountreserved) and its band identity (categoryId, overdueInDays) from GET /v1/provisioningentries/{id}/entries, as produced by POST /provisioningentries.
capabilities.evidence: Capture ENT-04 under tenant gerege: the running oracle returned four aggregated entries (STANDARD 1066.19, SUB-STANDARD 26654.63, DOUBTFUL 74234.32, LOSS 106618.53), each with categoryId and overdueInDays.

capabilities.name: criteria-band
capabilities.description: Select the ONE provisioning criteria age band whose closed interval [minAge, maxAge] contains a loan's overdue age, and read its category (id and name), reserve percentage (integer micro-per-cent) and liability/expense GL account pair. This is the oracle's join predicate pcd.min_age <= overdueInDays AND overdueInDays <= pcd.max_age.
capabilities.evidence: Capture CRI-02 under tenant gerege (criteriaId 1, SEED-Probe-Criteria, loan product 2) gives the four definitions: STANDARD [0,29] 1.00% liability 2 expense 4, SUB-STANDARD [30,59] 25.00%, DOUBTFUL [60,89] 50.00%, LOSS [90,36500] 100.00%. Capture ENT-04 records the four observed decisions: overdue 0 -> STANDARD, 31 -> SUB-STANDARD, 62 -> DOUBTFUL, 92 -> LOSS. The percentage is transcribed in integer micro-per-cent (1.00 -> 1000000), never as a float.

seams.name: provisioning-category-read
seams.description: GET /v1/provisioningcategory on the running Fineract server (Path B), tenant gerege: the m_provision_category aggregate rows.

seams.name: provisioning-entry-reserve
seams.description: POST /provisioningentries then GET /v1/provisioningentries/{id}/entries on the running Fineract server, tenant gerege: the aggregated reserve amount and band identity per entry.

seams.name: provisioning-criteria-band
seams.description: Replay the committed CRI-02 criteria definitions (GET /v1/provisioningcriteria/1) plus one overdue age through the oracle's join predicate pcd.min_age <= overdueInDays AND overdueInDays <= pcd.max_age; the selected definition's category, reserve percentage and GL accounts are pinned by the ENT-04 observed decisions (0/31/62/92).

note: Provisioning parity-store capability registry. Each capabilities_required name on a vector must map, on the vector's seam, to status exercised, and the capability must be in the graded domain, else the vector is refused (default-deny). Three capabilities are graded: the category aggregate read (provisioning-category-read seam), the aggregated reserve amount (provisioning-entry-reserve seam), and the age-band selection rule (provisioning-criteria-band seam): the criteria definitions are the observed CRI-02 capture and the four selections are the observed ENT-04 decisions, replayed as a seam so ReserveRate and Matches are reached. The overlap invariant (Overlaps/ValidateRange) is NOT in the graded domain: the running oracle produced no overlap refusal to transcribe, and producing one would write a deliberately-broken criteria to the tenant (forbidden).
